title: Data Scientist
description:
Are you building LLM, RAG or AI-powered search solutions and looking for your next challenge?

London (Hybrid)

I'm working with a global organisation seeking a Data Scientist to help develop next-generation AI products focused on knowledge discovery, intelligent search, and scientific insight generation.

With a long-standing heritage supporting the Life Science Industry, this organisation is now at the forefront of applying AI-native technologies to transform how professionals discover, evaluate and interact with complex information.

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience across:

  • LLMs & Generative AI
  • RAG & Retrieval Systems
  • Semantic Search & Information Retrieval
  • NLP & Embeddings
  • Agentic AI Workflows (LangGraph, LangChain etc.)
  • Production AI & MLOps

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI products that combine large-scale data, search and generative AI to solve complex real-world problems.

This role is based in London and offers hybrid working.
